description.en: What joined the engine from the design specimen, each in its zone.
description.zh: 从设计样本并入引擎的东西，各在各的区域。

description.en: Figure, world and text, as the engine draws them.
description.zh: 图、物、文，引擎画出来的样子。

text.en: Nobody draws the tangent here. The [secant](noun:value) through $P$ and a second point $Q$ is drawn again and again as $Q$ comes in, each one left behind in transparent ink. Where they all agree the ink is deepest, and that is the tangent; then it turns from a guess (dashed, hollow) into a fact (solid).
text.zh: 这里没有人画切线。过 $P$ 和另一点 $Q$ 的[割线](noun:value)随着 $Q$ 靠近一遍遍画出来，每一条都用透明墨水留在纸上。它们都同意的地方墨最深，那就是切线；最后它从猜测（虚线、空心）变成事实（实线）。

caption.en: The [curve](noun:function) $f$, the point $P$, and the secants as $h$ is halved.
caption.zh: [曲线](noun:function) $f$、点 $P$，以及 $h$ 不断减半时的割线。

text.en: Try another function: the same picture works for any curve smooth at $P$.
text.zh: 换一个函数：只要曲线在 $P$ 处光滑，同样的画面都成立。

text.en: A thrown [ball](noun:ball) leaves its past on the paper: where it was every tenth of a second, and the next third of a second dashed, as a guess. Look at the spacing before any number. Across, the ghosts are evenly spaced; up, they close together toward the top and open out on the way down.
text.zh: 抛出去的[球](noun:ball)把它的过去留在纸上：每 0.1 秒所在的位置，以及接下来 0.35 秒的虚线，那是一个猜测。先别看数字，看间距。横着看，影子间隔均匀；竖着看，越接近顶点挤得越紧，下落时又拉开。

caption.en: The last tenth of a second as its two legs: [across](noun:horizontal) never changes, [up](noun:vertical) shrinks to nothing at the top (ticked), then turns downward. Drag the arrow and let go to throw again.
caption.zh: 最近 0.1 秒拆成两段：[横向](noun:horizontal)始终不变，[竖直](noun:vertical)在顶点（刻线处）缩成零，然后转为向下。拖动箭头再松手，可以重新抛。

text.en: Nothing pushes the ball sideways, so it keeps its horizontal speed; gravity takes the same amount off its vertical speed every tenth of a second. The parabola is just these two facts drawn together.
text.zh: 没有东西横着推球，所以水平速度保持不变；重力每 0.1 秒从竖直速度里减去同样多。抛物线不过是把这两件事画在一起。

title.en: Text: a definition in its sentence, a chain of why
title.zh: 文 · 句子里的定义，一串为什么

text.en: The [derivative](def: the limit of $\dfrac{f(x_0+h)-f(x_0)}{h}$ as $h \to 0$, when that limit exists; then $f$ is [differentiable](def: having a derivative) at $x_0$) of $f$ at $x_0$ is the [slope](noun:value) the secants close onto. Tap a dotted word: its definition opens where you are reading, and the sentence carries on after it.
text.zh: $f$ 在 $x_0$ 处的[导数](def: 当 $h \to 0$ 时 $\dfrac{f(x_0+h)-f(x_0)}{h}$ 的极限（如果这个极限存在）；这时称 $f$ 在 $x_0$ [可导](def: 导数存在)) 就是割线最后合拢到的那个[斜率](noun:value)。点一下带虚线的词：定义就在你正在读的地方展开，读完句子照常往下走。

claim.en: A function differentiable at $x_0$ is continuous there.
claim.zh: 在 $x_0$ 可导的函数，在那里一定连续。

text.en: $f(x_0+h) - f(x_0)$ is the quotient times $h$, and the product tends to $f'(x_0) \cdot 0 = 0$.
text.zh: $f(x_0+h) - f(x_0)$ 等于差商乘以 $h$，而这个乘积趋于 $f'(x_0) \cdot 0 = 0$。

text.en: A limit of a product is the product of the limits, when both exist.
text.zh: 两个极限都存在时，乘积的极限等于极限的乘积。
所以 $f(x_0+h) \to f(x_0)$：在 $x_0$ 处没有跳跃。
在 $x_0$ 连续说的正是这件事。

text.en: The rings are hollow while a reason is only claimed; open one and it fills. The chain stops where there is nothing left to ask: a definition, or an assumption we agree to take.
text.zh: 一个理由只是被断言时，圆环是空心的；打开它，它就填满。链条停在无可再问的地方：一个定义，或一个我们同意接受的假设。
